population.eligibility.value: Products with configured minimum and purchase quantity

value: 2019 forecast monthly demand; absent months zero demand

value.description: Month pre_end=previous final ending-budget; strictly below minimum triggers one qty_purchase added immediately; final ending=pre_end+purchase; select minimum abs(final ending-minimum), earliest month on ties

candidates.sql: WITH RECURSIVE months(n,mth) AS (SELECT 1,'2019-01-01' UNION ALL SELECT n+1,date(mth,'+1 month') FROM months WHERE n<12), seed AS (SELECT m.product_id,m.qty_minimum,m.qty_purchase,COALESCE(SUM(i.qty),0) initial FROM product_minimums m LEFT JOIN inventory i ON m.product_id=i.product_id GROUP BY m.product_id,m.qty_minimum,m.qty_purchase), needs AS (SELECT s.*,m.n,m.mth,COALESCE(b.qty,0) demand FROM seed s CROSS JOIN months m LEFT JOIN monthly_budget b ON s.product_id=b.product_id AND m.mth=b.mth), sim(product_id,n,mth,qty_minimum,qty_purchase,initial,demand,opening,pre_end,replenish,ending) AS (SELECT product_id,0,'2018-12-01',qty_minimum,qty_purchase,initial,0,initial,initial,0,initial FROM seed UNION ALL SELECT s.product_id,b.n,b.mth,s.qty_minimum,s.qty_purchase,s.initial,b.demand,s.ending,s.ending-b.demand,CASE WHEN s.ending-b.demand<s.qty_minimum THEN s.qty_purchase ELSE 0 END,s.ending-b.demand+CASE WHEN s.ending-b.demand<s.qty_minimum THEN s.qty_purchase ELSE 0 END FROM sim s JOIN needs b ON s.product_id=b.product_id AND b.n=s.n+1), ranked AS (SELECT product_id,mth,ABS(ending-qty_minimum) absolute_difference,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY ABS(ending-qty_minimum),mth) rn FROM sim WHERE n>0) SELECT product_id,mth AS month,absolute_difference FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY product_id
